root_cause.text: The mt7915_crash_data structure is freed in mt7915_coredump_unregister() without first canceling the dump_work workqueue item, allowing mt7915_mac_dump_work() to execute concurrently and dereference the already-freed crash_data pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cancel_work_sync(&dev->dump_work)` at the beginning of mt7915_unregister_device(), before the call to `mt7915_coredump_unregister(dev)` which performs `vfree(dev->coredump.crash_data)`. The CVE description explicitly shows the race condition where CPU 0 frees crash_data via vfree() while CPU 1's mt7915_mac_dump_work() is still executing and accessing the freed memory. The fix ensures the work is synchronized and canceled before any deallocation occurs.

The fix ensures the work item is fully synchronized and canceled before the crash_data is deallocated, preventing the use-after-free.
